production: ImageGen creative source + deterministic extraction/alpha cleanup/resizing/seam conditioning

visual_contract.view: rear-camera 3/4 perspective runner with warm sunrise
visual_contract.style: clean HD hand-painted game art with slightly awkward-cute silhouettes
visual_contract.lighting: soft golden sunrise from upper right with restrained cool mist
forbidden: static road baked into environment plate

environment.transform: symmetric center crop to 864x1536, then high-quality downsample to 720x1280
environment.center_lane: clear misty valley from lower edge to distant gate; moving path is supplied independently
environment.runtime_note: The authored source is 1024x1536. If a taller fixed-width viewport is used, crop only side scenery or use a viewport contract; do not stretch the lane.

runner.anchor: feet/bottom with eight pixels of lower transparent padding
runner.filtering: integer-safe pixel preserving placement; no runtime smoothing requirement is imposed by these HD assets

obstacles.hurdle: raw/obstacle_hurdle_raw_v2.png; solid beam barrier, jump-only read
obstacles.arch: raw/obstacle_arch_raw_v2.png; short low-clearance opening, slide read
obstacles.discarded_pack_cells: The grouped pack is preserved as raw provenance; its rubble cell crossed the seam and is not used at runtime.

path.repeat: horizontal and vertical; deterministic opposite-edge conditioning produced exact edge equality
